object: QSigma-R6i - Blind coherent-dilation test of the fixed-width one-bit ceiling

baseline.envelopes: 25/25 artifact digests verified; commit and independence warnings remain

question: Can a structurally different fixed-width map retain the contraction defect coherently and exceed the one-bit Holevo ceiling of the existing normalize-and-post-select R6 map?

candidate_map.input: A = M / ||M||_2 for M in SL(2,R)
candidate_map.reference: the existing 5-dimensional R6 Bell-plus-erasure state on exactly the same source points

primary_metrics: Holevo chi for the coherent-dilation ensemble
Holevo chi for the matched R6 ensemble
achievable PGM mutual information for both ensembles
secondary_diagnostics: density trace, Hermiticity, positivity, and purity
common-unitary gauge invariance of chi and PGM

decision_rule.RESCUE_FOR_THIS_MAP: At each of three consecutive preregistered sizes N >= 64, both chi_H - chi_R6 > 0.001 bits and I_PGM_H - I_PGM_R6 > 0.001 bits at at least one preregistered depth.
decision_rule.NO_RESCUE_FOR_THIS_MAP: At every preregistered depth and size, both improvements are <= 0.001 bits.
decision_rule.HOLD: Any other result, including a metric split, numerical-control failure, or insufficient consecutive-size support.

predictions.statement: Outcome deliberately withheld: the coherent dilation may or may not beat the R6 map. No direction is preregistered as expected.
The Julia/Halmos block is unitary to numerical tolerance for every preregistered source point.

The pointwise dilation is not assumed to be a homomorphism. Any nonzero composition defect confines a positive result to state encoding and forbids calling it a finite-dimensional unitary representation of SL(2,R).

controls: Use byte-identical source coordinate lists and uniform priors for the R6 and dilation ensembles.
Verify U_A unitarity before constructing each Choi-vector state.
Verify every emitted state is Hermitian, positive semidefinite, trace one, and pure within tolerance.
Repeat one frozen ensemble after source-order permutation; chi and PGM must be invariant.
Conjugate every codeword by one common frozen unitary; chi and PGM must be invariant.
Embed every codeword into a larger zero-padded carrier; chi and PGM must be invariant.
Recompute the existing R6 analytic ceiling chi <= 1 + exp(-4 rho) on the matched ensemble.
Measure, rather than assume away, the composition defect of the dilation.
kill_conditions: Any change to depths, codebook sizes, priors, tolerance, decision margin, or decision rule after the first primary result is visible.
R6 and dilation ensembles do not use exactly the same source points.
Any unitarity, density-state, permutation, gauge, or passive-padding control fails.
A positive result is generalized beyond this one dilation.
A pointwise dilation is called a group representation without a vanishing composition defect.
The result is described as quantum advantage, asymptotic capacity, hardware evidence, cognition, consciousness, or AGI.

evidence_floor.P: the Julia/Halmos dilation identity and finite-dimensional density-state checks
evidence_floor.M: the frozen finite-grid chi and PGM measurements
evidence_floor.H: whether this map is useful beyond the measured grids
evidence_floor.S: any general fixed-width impossibility or rescue theorem
evidence_floor.R: the infinite-dimensional unitary-representation and energy-constrained truncation branch

scope_remainders.statement: A unitary dilation of each contraction is a point encoding unless composition is preserved. It does not evade the theorem excluding faithful finite-dimensional unitary representations of a non-compact semisimple group.
Holevo chi is an upper bound and PGM information is one achievable lower bound. This round is not a coding theorem or a regularized-capacity calculation.

The preregistered seven-term R6h law failed and the four-term split was post hoc. It is not used as a primary gate here; it remains an exploratory calibration until rebuilt with dimensionless, independently evaluated components.

stop_condition: Stop after one frozen execution, matched controls, an evidence envelope, focused and full regression, and a bounded result note. Do not tune a failed gate and do not open the infinite-dimensional truncation branch in this round.
